title: List the agents on a host
description: Section 7. Every later connection starts with host/hello. host/agents lists the host's agents; each one is an agent channel.

steps.note: Open a connection to the host (through its relay, or on the LAN).
The first frame is host/hello: the versions this client speaks and the device credential from pairing.
The host picks 0.1 and says which device this connection is. `info` is the same object host/info returns.
Which agents does this computer have?
Each agent: its id (the channel name), label, runtime, folder, whether it is online, and its ACP capabilities. The suite's agent is the one `--agent` names.
What is waiting for an answer across every agent (an inbox). Nothing yet.
The list; a host with other agents may have items of theirs.
